definitions: simple past and past participle of alienate

blocks.text: Alienated is a Canadian science fiction television series. It was set and filmed in Victoria, British Columbia. The series premiered July 8, 2003 on Space and lasted for two seasons.
Diagnosis: Murder's sixth season originally aired Thursdays at 9:00–10:00 p.m. (ET/PT) on CBS. The season was released on DVD complete and available in two parts by Visual Entertainment, Inc.

"Alienated" is a song by English singer-songwriter Zayn. It was released on 12 April 2024 through Mercury and Republic Records as the second single from his fourth studio album, Room Under the Stairs. Zayn wrote the song with Daniel Zaidenstadt and produced it alongside American record producer Dave Cobb.
